name: Softcat plc
research_rationale: Filing-aligned quality and FY2026 FCF still support the screen buy, but rich valuation, margin compression, sub-1× management cash dividend cover and GDT leverage keep the overlay at accumulate.

weekly_updates.summary:
No new RNS in the 7 Nov news batch; press continues to flag post-results share weakness and net margin ~7.6% vs ~9.1% YoY.  
Screen remains buy (7w persistent); filing-aligned FCF £150.9m now matches screen TTM, closing October’s FCF basis gap.  
Sep-2026 placing/retail offer materials for the GDT acquisition remain the main leverage overlay; Piotroski still 6/9 on leverage and gross margin.

8 Nov news batch is empty: no new RNS, press, or filings since the 7 Nov verdict.  
Screen still **buy** (7/22, stable); persistence is **8 weeks** (was 7); headline yield **2.8%** in the latest snapshot.  
Prior overlays unchanged: GDT funding/leverage, ~7.6% net margin, Piotroski **6/9**, weak management cash dividend cover.
